data: synthetic: #102's queue-reactive days (a simulator with made-up parameters), no market data. The Hyperliquid capture enters only through a state coverage diagnostic: it holds no orders of our own, so no action, behaviour policy or propensity
bounds: One synthetic simulator whose rows do not react to orders, made-up parameters and 24 days per regime bound what this study can show. Every value is labelled [observed] (read from a log), [estimated] (an off-policy estimate under its stated assumption) or [simulated] (an interactive run of the target in the same simulator).
disclosure: #102 has already evaluated its arms on these holdout days (days 20 to 24). No estimator, threshold or choice of this study reads a holdout log before this study's freeze.

reuses.what: the regimes, days, splits, kernel, main execution (fees, limits, queue model, latency), the maskable grid, the selected classical points and the frozen maskable PPO runs of #102

splits.train: days 1 to 14: fit of the direct method and of any counted propensity
splits.validation: days 15 to 19: choice of the estimator settings below, and the stop rule
splits.holdout: days 20 to 24: the go or no-go, read once after this study's freeze

log.propensity: the behaviour's probability of the logged joint action given the observation and the mask, computed by the behaviour itself
log.reward: the environment's exact reward per decision, as a float for the estimators; the exact daily net is kept beside it

action_space: #102's maskable grid: hold, or a quote of bid offset x ask offset x bid size x ask size over offsets [0, 1, 2, 4, 8] ticks from the observed mid and sizes [1, 2] lots, each restricted by the mask. A joint action is one of these, so a probability is over joint actions

as_grid_eps30.explore: with probability epsilon: a hold with probability 1/2, otherwise a quote drawn uniformly over the quotes the mask allows

as_grid_eps30_counted.propensity: dropped from the log, and counted from the training logs over the states binned as below; the control for unrecorded probabilities

as_grid.rule: Avellaneda-Stoikov at #102's selected point of the regime (risk aversion 0.01, order intensity 50, the regime's volatility from the training days, horizon one day), with the time left taken as steps left x 10 s and the inventory as the delivered position: the reservation price and the half spread give a bid and an ask distance from the mid in ticks, each rounded to the nearest grid offset (the smaller one on a tie, and 0 below 0), size 1 lot on each side; a hold when the mask allows no such quote
as_grid.note: a projection of Avellaneda-Stoikov on the grid, not #102's continuous Avellaneda-Stoikov arm

targets.fixed_spread_4: #102's selected fixed spread: offsets 4 and 4 ticks, size 1 lot
targets.maskable_ppo: #102's frozen maskable PPO, set 0, seeds 1 to 5, deterministic as #102 evaluated it (the most likely value of each dimension under the mask); each seed is a target

out_of_support_by_construction.residual_sac: a deterministic continuous correction of a continuous quote: it has no probability against a discrete behaviour
out_of_support_by_construction.avellaneda_stoikov_continuous: a continuous price, not a grid action

seeds.environment_seed: the behaviour seed, given to reset

truth: each target run interactively on the same days, with the same execution, environment seed 101 as #102's evaluation, labelled [simulated]. The rows do not react to orders, so it is exact for this simulator and says nothing about a market's reaction. It is never an input to a choice, a threshold or the decision
estimand: a target's mean daily net over the days of a split, from its own interactive run

estimators.pdwis: per-decision weighted importance sampling over a day, the ratio products from the day's first decision, self-normalized per decision across the days and behaviour seeds
estimators.pdwis_window: the same with each ratio product over the last w decisions only, which assumes that an action's effect on the reward fades after w decisions; w from window_choices
estimators.dm: the direct method: a ridge regression of the per-decision reward on features of (observation, action), fitted on training logs, summed over the logged states with the target's action; it assumes the target reaches the logged states, which a policy that changes the position does not
estimators.dr: per-decision doubly robust from pdwis_window and dm

estimator_settings.choice_rule: on validation logs, per behaviour: the window with the largest effective sample size among those whose effective sample size is at least the threshold, and otherwise the shortest; the ridge alpha with the lowest squared error of the per-decision reward on validation logs. Neither reads a target's truth

diagnostics.effective_sample: per target: (sum of weights)^2 / sum of squared weights of the chosen estimator's final weights, as a share of the decisions
diagnostics.low_propensity: the share of the target's actions, over the logged decisions, whose behaviour propensity is under 0.0001
diagnostics.zero_propensity: the count of logged decisions where the target's action has propensity 0 under the behaviour
diagnostics.cross_check: whether the 90 % intervals of the chosen importance estimator and of dr overlap

decision_rule.per: target x behaviour, on the holdout logs

reasons.no_recorded_propensity: the behaviour's log has no recorded propensity
reasons.out_of_support: zero_propensity > 0, or the target is out of support by construction
reasons.no_cross_check: cross_check could not be computed, and no other reason holds

decision_rule.go: no reason holds. A go says only that these checks found nothing against reading the estimates for that target on that log; it does not say they are right, or that the target is good
decision_rule.real_data: no-go for learning or evaluating a policy offline from the capture: it holds no orders of our own, hence no action, behaviour policy or propensity. Its rewards could only be simulated consequences

intervals.kind: 90 % moving block bootstrap over days of the per-day estimator terms, as #102
intervals.note: statistical only; a counted propensity is held fixed

stop_rules: Consistency, before any estimate: the logged run of fixed_spread_4 with no exploration must reproduce #102's interactive daily net of its fixed spread arm on validation days, at environment seed 101, exactly. Otherwise stop and report.
On validation: if no target other than as_grid has an effective sample of at least 0.05 under as_grid_eps30, stop, report the no-go with its diagnostics, and do not open the holdout logs.
Compute: a step that overruns its estimate by more than 50 % stops and is reported, without cutting seeds.

coverage.what: the share of the capture's decisions whose binned state falls in a bin the synthetic training logs reach, and the share of the synthetic logs' decisions in bins the capture reaches
coverage.bins: spread in ticks (1, 2, 3 to 4, 5 to 8, more), the absolute mid change in ticks since the previous decision (0, 1, 2 to 4, more), the imbalance in quintiles of the synthetic training logs
coverage.capture: #257's replay of the Hyperliquid capture, BTC December 2025, the longest warm stretch, rows sampled every 10 s as #102's days; the coordinator runs it and sends the counts, as the capture stays off this repository
coverage.label: [observed] for the capture's states; it says where a simulator-trained policy would act outside the states it saw, not how well

compute.estimate: logs: 72 days x 2 behaviours x 5 seeds x 8640 decisions, about 6.2M environment steps; truth: 72 days x 8 targets x 1 seed, about 5M steps. To be measured on one day before the full run

follow_up: offline policy training (behaviour cloning, a conservative offline method) is #280, not this study
